description: Baseline Electron knowledge base with minimal harness

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions and preload script
features.evidence: Verified on 2026-08-09: npm run dev opens Electron window at 1200x800 with preload loaded, contextIsolation=true, and nodeIntegration=false.

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with empty state message
features.evidence: Verified on 2026-08-09: the left sidebar renders a seeded document list from the local knowledge-base-data directory and shows the current selection state.

features.name: Question Panel
features.description: Bottom input bar accepts questions and submits via IPC
features.evidence: Verified on 2026-08-09: the question bar submits through window.knowledgeBase.qa.ask and renders the returned answer plus cited documents.

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: Verified on 2026-08-09: the app creates ~/Library/Application Support/knowledge-base/knowledge-base-data with documents and index subdirectories and seeds local catalog/history files.
